mn85:3.3: ‘Sir, Prince Bodhi bows with his head to the Buddha’s feet, and asks if he is healthy and well, nimble, strong, and living comfortably.’
mn85:4.2: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side. Seated to one side, the student Sañjikāputta said to the Buddha:
mn85:4.3: “Prince Bodhi bows with his head to the feet of the worthy Gotama, and asks if he is healthy and well, nimble, strong, and living comfortably.
mn85:4.5: ‘May the worthy Gotama accept tomorrow’s meal from Prince Bodhi together with the mendicant Saṅgha.’”

mn85:51.17: The Realized One is Perfected, a fully awakened Buddha.
mn85:51.18: Listen up, mendicants: I have achieved freedom from death! I shall instruct you, I will teach you the Dhamma.
mn85:51.19: By practicing as instructed you will soon realize the supreme culmination of the spiritual path in this very life. You will live having achieved with your own insight the goal for which gentlemen rightly go forth from the lay life to homelessness.’
